I’m based in Munich, Germany, and work on software that combines engineering, research, and product thinking.
What kind of work do you do?

I build end-to-end software experiences, from product ideas and technical architecture to implementation and iteration. I’m especially interested in applications that are practical, useful, and technically elegant.
What do you enjoy most about software engineering?
I enjoy turning complex problems into clear solutions. The best engineering work is not just technically strong—it also improves how people experience and interact with technology.

My experience spans frontend engineering, software innovation, and automotive software development. I’ve worked with teams in agile and structured environments and have contributed across product, implementation, and research-driven development.
What industries have you worked in?

I’ve worked in automotive software, product engineering, and digital innovation. My experience has taught me how to adapt engineering practices to different domains while keeping the user and business goals in view.
Do you work with product and design teams?
Yes. I value collaboration across engineering, design, and product. Good software is often the result of combining technical feasibility with strong product thinking and user empathy.
What do you like outside of work?
I enjoy football, travel, photography, reading, and staying curious about emerging technologies and how they shape the future.
What topics do you like to explore?
I’m interested in software engineering, UX, emerging tech, AI, autonomous systems, and the way technology influences everyday life and business.
